# Snadcat
# Regenerated by `snadcat init`. Everything else under .devcontainer/
# is regenerated on next init or contains per-machine state; only
# devbox.tools.json is your project-shared tool list and stays in git.
# Snadcat manages this whole block; re-running init with
# `--features no-gitignore` (or SNADCAT_GITIGNORE=false) removes it.
.devcontainer/*
!.devcontainer/devbox.tools.json
.snadcat/settings.local.json
# /Snadcat
